scenarios.title: Daily commute
scenarios.brief: You ride a loud train 45 minutes each way and want earbuds that block noise and last the whole trip. Your budget is $150.

scenarios.title: Workouts
scenarios.brief: You lift and run four times a week and need earbuds that stay put and survive sweat. Your budget is $100.

scenarios.title: Work calls
scenarios.brief: You take video calls most of the day and switch between laptop and phone. You want clear calls and all-day comfort. Your budget is $200.
